correctness.rationale: Under seven mutually independent Bernoulli inputs and two-of-three local majority activation, independent-child recursion gives F_p(x,y)=p(x+y)+(1-2p)xy. With u=F_p(q,q), v=F_p(u,q), the two exact root and internal-count differences factor as stated. Positivity of p^2+(1-2p)q for interior p,q proves the sharp 1/2 transition. A distinct 128-case enumeration verified both whole polynomial identities and 68 exact-rational assertions. Boundaries and four-leaf minimality are explicit.

value.rationale: This is the smallest nontrivial complete topological classification for strictly binary confluence trees: at four headwaters there are two and only two shapes. It gives an exact threshold, invariant in leaf input q, where ranking by outlet risk and expected internal spread is strictly opposite. Such conflicting natural observables in even the smallest cascade are consequential for interpreting simplified flood-connectivity and monitoring models. No empirical-calibration or general larger-tree significance is claimed.
